capability.summary: Run the default recursive `go test ./...` command from one Go project path
capability.description: Uses a supplied directory as the working directory or an existing file's parent, then compiles and executes tests for all recursively matched Go packages. It captures raw stdout/stderr and treats only Go exit code 0 as success.
capability.problem_space: Default recursive Go package test execution; not coverage collection, test-result parsing, single-test selection, formatting, static analysis, or arbitrary Go command execution.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing Go project directory or file whose parent becomes cwd; output: JSON process envelope with actual Go exit code and full raw stdout/stderr.
accepted_inputs: an existing Go module or package directory from which `go test ./...` can run
an existing file path whose parent directory should be used as the Go test working directory
constraint.output_shape: Passing run: {status: "success", tool: "go", target: string, exit_code: 0, result: null, stdout: string, stderr: string|null}. Failed tests, compilation failures, or other nonzero Go results use the same keys with status="tool_error" and propagate Go's actual exit code. Non-existing input, missing Go executable, or 300-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "go", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: always runs `go test ./...` with no package selection, test name filter, count, race, tags, timeout, verbosity, JSON, or passthrough flags
does not enable coverage or parse tests into structured cases; result is null and output remains raw stdout/stderr
a supplied file is not tested individually and only selects its parent as cwd
executes project code and compilation, may populate Go caches or trigger test-defined side effects, uses a fixed 300-second timeout, and does not truncate output

output_contract.description: JSON process envelope for recursive `go test ./...`, containing target, actual exit code, and full raw stdout/stderr without coverage metrics.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: run all recursive Go package tests
execute the default go test ./... command
negative_intents: collect Go test coverage or generate a coverprofile
run a selected Go test or pass custom test flags
format lint build or statically inspect Go source without running tests
